Name: SocialMenuInteraction
Author: canre02
Description:
Social Menu Interaction
[heading]Description[/heading]
This mod lets you talk to NPCs and give them gifts directly from the in-game social menu (the character tab, opened by pressing J). No more running around the map hunting down villagers for your daily rounds -- just open the social page, click a button, and you are done. Friendship changes, gift taste reactions, and dialogue are all processed through the vanilla game API, so everything works exactly as if you walked up to the NPC in person.
[line]
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[b]Requirements:[/b] SMAPI 4.0+ and Stardew Valley 1.6+.
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI installed. If not, download it from smapi.io.[/*]
[*]Download the SocialMenuInteraction.zip file.[/*]
[*]Extract the zip. You should see a folder named 
[code]StardewSocialMenu[/code].[/*]
[*]Move or copy that folder into your 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code] directory.
The final structure should look like this:
Stardew Valley/
+-- Mods/
+-- StardewSocialMenu/
+-- manifest.json
+-- StardewSocialMenu.dll
+-- i18n/
+-- default.json
+-- zh.json[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI (not the vanilla Stardew Valley.exe).[/*]
[/list]To verify the mod loaded successfully, check the SMAPI console for these lines:
text
[Social Menu Interaction] Social Menu Interaction mod loaded.
[Social Menu Interaction]  Click the Talk/Gift buttons in the social menu to interact remotely.
[Social Menu Interaction] Harmony patches applied successfully.
[line]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[b]Remote Gift Giving[/b]
Click the Gift button next to any NPC in the social menu. A backpack-style inventory panel opens; click any item to give it as a gift. The NPC's reaction dialogue appears immediately. Friendship points, birthday bonuses (x8 multiplier), and gift taste preferences are all calculated by the vanilla API. The mod respects the standard limits -- one gift per NPC per day, two per week -- and shows clear warning messages when those limits have been reached.
[b]Remote Talking[/b]
Click the Talk button to see the NPC's current daily dialogue. The content is pulled directly from the game's dialogue data, so it matches what you would see if you walked up and talked to them in person. After talking, the "Talked Today" checkbox in the social menu is automatically checked.
[b]UI Integration[/b]
Two compact buttons (Gift on the left, Talk on the right) appear on each NPC row in the social page. Their positions are calculated from the row bounds and adjust correctly when scrolling. Button opacity is user-configurable, and hover highlighting gives clear visual feedback.
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu Support[/b]
If Generic Mod Config Menu is installed, all settings can be changed from the in-game options menu. The configuration is split into two pages:
[list]
[*]Global Settings: master toggles for the Talk and Gift buttons, plus an opacity slider.[/*]
[*]Per-NPC Settings: independent Talk and Gift toggles for every villager. Disabling a specific NPC's toggle hides that button from their row, overriding the global setting.[/*]
[/list][b]Localization[/b]
English and Simplified Chinese are built in. The mod auto-switches based on the game's language setting.
[line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/b] (download from smapi.io)[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional, for in-game configuration) -- available on Nexus Mods[/*]
[/list][line]
